schedule.note: install-launchd.sh derives launchd's StartCalendarInterval array from this (one entry per intervalHours step within activeHours) -- re-run it after changing either value. daily-check.sh also re-checks activeHours itself at runtime as a safety net (stale plist, manual/RunAtLoad firing), same belt-and-suspenders pattern as the sibling calendar-sync project's sync-schedule.mjs.

timeSlots.note: Used only to narrow the search window for continuous-recording splitting (see docs/continuous-recording-splitting.md) -- never as the cut point itself. Duplicated from the sibling attendance/calendar-sync projects' own timeSlots, deliberately not shared -- keep in sync by hand if the schedule ever changes.

notifications.note: Separate Gmail-send-only OAuth token from googleOAuth above -- see lib/gmailAuth.mjs for why. from == toEmail (own account, Gmail send-only token can only send as itself); additionalRecipients are extra To: addresses that get the report but aren't the sending account.

sessionOverrides.note: Hand-confirmed corrections to recordings-sheet rows (the sheet isn't ours to edit), keyed "<date> <row start time> <DSM code>" -> { session?, faculty? }. The sync applies them to file names and renames the matching Drive files on its next run. Session numbers: DSM 101/104/108's repeated numbers fill their gaps exactly in date order; DSM 103 had several back-to-back sessions the sheet wasn't updated for, so every DSM 103 recording is numbered strictly by date/time order, 1, 2, 3, ... with no gaps (user's choice 2026-10-08, re-confirmed 2026-10-14 over the official timetable, which has no slot for the extra 09-19 class). The first pass on 2026-10-08 wrongly kept the sheet's numbers from 08-29 on, leaving a false gap at 4 -- the timetable confirms 08-29 is session 4. DSM 101 stays in date order where the timetable swaps 09-10/09-12 (user's choice). Faculty: the 09-02/09-04 rows had instructors crossed between courses -- these were hand-corrected on Drive earlier and are recorded here so the sync keeps them.

sessionOffsets.note: Standing per-course shift added to the recordings sheet's session number from a date onward, for when the sheet's count runs consistently behind date order -- so each new recording doesn't need its own sessionOverrides entry. Per course, the latest rule whose 'from' is on or before the session date applies; an explicit sessionOverrides entry always wins. DSM 103: the sheet (like the timetable) has no number for the extra 09-19 class, so from 10-08 on it is 1 behind date order (sheet 11 on 10-08 = session 12). DSM 101: the sheet and timetable labels skip 24 (10-07 is 23, 10-12 is labelled 25), but 10-12 was the 24th DSM 101 class held -- attendance (which counts held classes) marked it Session 24 -- so from 10-12 on the sheet is 1 ahead.

sessionLedger.note: After every run the corrected session numbering (course + date + start time -> session number and file name) is written to `file` for the sibling msdsm-notes/attendance tools to look up, and checked against attendance's own run log; each disagreement is flagged once in the report email. Holds Drive file IDs, so it stays outside every repo. crossCheckSince skips the weeks before attendance was automated.

courseFaculty.note: Transcribed from the schedule sheet's own instructor legend (last tab) -- used only to flag (never auto-correct) a Faculty-column value in the recordings sheet that doesn't match any listed instructor for that course. Re-transcribe if the legend changes (e.g. next term).
